blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. on Friday dismissed Sen. Panfilo “Ping” Lacson’s call for him to reassess his current economic team. In a social media post, Lacson raised concerns about an “economic malaise,” or a prolonged period of sluggish economic growth. Lacson told Marcos that it might be time to “look hard” at his economic managers. READ: Lacson urges Marcos to reassess economic team amid ‘malaise’ But Marcos said there was no need to reevaluate his current economic managers. “I don’t… I disagree with him, I’m sorry, but I disagree with him.
